data.statement: Add AudioMancer-branded built-in UI themes (AudioMancer Dark, AudioMancer Parchment) derived from the product hero posters (deep teal ground, gold accent, cream text) to ui_theme_service, and set AudioMancer Dark as the default UI theme. Cosmetic-only; reuses the existing 10 THEME_COLOR_ROLES and theme schema.

acceptance: built_in_themes() includes a built_in theme with theme_id 'audiomancer_dark' whose roles are window_background #0B2429, panel_background #10313A, text_primary #F1E9DA, text_muted #98AEAC, accent #E3AC52, border #22474D, warning #E0A82E, success #58A877, danger #DA655C, disabled #5E7A78.

built_in_themes() includes a built_in theme with theme_id 'audiomancer_parchment' whose roles are window_background #F1E8D6, panel_background #FFFDF6, text_primary #17292C, text_muted #5B6D6B, accent #B07A22, border #E4D8C0, warning #A6701A, success #2F7A4E, danger #A93C36, disabled #A99F8B.
theme_by_id() with an unresolved id returns the built-in default theme (resolved theme_id equals default_theme_id()), keeping REQ-UX-ce3d3202 green after the default change.
Every built-in theme (including the 2 new) passes validate_theme_payload with built_in True, all 10 color roles present and valid #RRGGBB, and built_in_themes() returns deep copies.
Full configured gates stay green: uv run pytest -q and ruff check .
assumptions: Making AudioMancer Dark the app default (not only selectable) was explicitly approved by the user when they chose 'Implementeaza tema (Pasul 1)', whose plan stated default_theme_id() should return audiomancer_dark.
classic_light and the other 4 existing themes remain in the catalog unchanged and keep their current order/index positions.
data.reason: Cosmetic, additive theme data plus a one-line default change and a fallback alignment; fully covered by focused tests, reuses the existing schema and roles, touches no workflow-domain data and no credential files, and is trivially reversible. The one opinionated call (Dark as default) was pre-approved by the user, so no open questions remain.
scope: IN: ui_theme_service._BUILT_IN_THEMES (append 2 themes), default_theme_id(), theme_by_id() fallback; extend test_built_in_themes_validate_and_are_deep_copied expected list; add focused tests for the 2 new themes' roles and the new default; keep REQ-UX-ce3d3202 (fallback follows default) green. OUT: QSS refinements, sidebar icons, Home stepper (later slices); settings_page theme picker UI; any credential file; workflow-domain services.
data.source: User chat request: implement the AudioMancer-branded UI theme approved in the redesign proposal (Pasul 1). Brand identity derived from hero posters in 07_Delivery/.
data.understanding: Add two new built-in UI themes to ui_theme_service._BUILT_IN_THEMES derived from the AudioMancer hero posters: 'AudioMancer Dark' (deep teal ground #0B2429, gold accent #E3AC52, cream text #F1E9DA) and 'AudioMancer Parchment' (warm cream ground #F1E8D6, deeper gold accent #B07A22, teal ink #17292C). Set default_theme_id() to 'audiomancer_dark' so the app opens in the brand look, and make theme_by_id() unresolved-id fallback resolve the default dynamically instead of hardcoded classic_light. Purely cosmetic: reuses the existing 10 THEME_COLOR_ROLES and theme schema (v1); no workflow-domain data, no logic, no persistence format change. classic_light stays at catalog index 0 to preserve mutation-safety checks.

data.rationale: The product brand (hero posters) is a deep-teal-and-gold cinematic identity; the desktop app needs a matching built-in theme so its look expresses the brand.
data.requirement: The built-in UI theme catalog shall include an 'AudioMancer Dark' theme (theme_id 'audiomancer_dark', built_in) whose color roles are window_background #0B2429, panel_background #10313A, text_primary #F1E9DA, text_muted #98AEAC, accent #E3AC52, border #22474D, warning #E0A82E, success #58A877, danger #DA655C, and disabled #5E7A78.

data.rationale: Operators who prefer a light UI need a daytime variant that keeps the AudioMancer brand (warm parchment ground, teal ink, deep-gold accent) instead of falling back to a generic light theme.
data.requirement: The built-in UI theme catalog shall include an 'AudioMancer Parchment' theme (theme_id 'audiomancer_parchment', built_in) whose color roles are window_background #F1E8D6, panel_background #FFFDF6, text_primary #17292C, text_muted #5B6D6B, accent #B07A22, border #E4D8C0, warning #A6701A, success #2F7A4E, danger #A93C36, and disabled #A99F8B.

data.rationale: The application should open in the branded look out of the box, and unresolved theme ids should fall back to the brand default (via the existing theme_by_id fallback contract).
data.requirement: The default built-in UI theme identifier returned by default_theme_id() shall be 'audiomancer_dark'.

Red (observed): with only QPushButton styled, QToolBar labels (Settings/AI/TTS/Help/About) render with default dark text on the AudioMancer Dark toolbar and are invisible; no QToolButton rule in the stylesheet.
Green: stylesheet now includes QToolBar + QToolButton rules using text_primary; toolbar labels legible on dark themes.

data.rationale: Toolbar actions are QToolButtons; with a stylesheet set but no QToolButton rules the native Windows style keeps default dark text, making labels like Settings/AI/TTS/Help/About invisible on a dark toolbar. Reported against the AudioMancer Dark default.
data.requirement: The theme stylesheet built by build_theme_stylesheet shall style QToolBar and QToolButton so top-toolbar action labels render with the theme text color and stay legible on the themed toolbar background for every built-in theme (including dark themes).

data.summary: Red: QGroupBox rule has no border-radius>=8 / panel background.
Red: buttons/inputs lack border-radius.
Red: no QScrollBar handle styling.
Red: combobox popup/QMenu not themed.
Red: QProgressBar chunk not accent-colored.
Green: QGroupBox rounded card (radius 10, panel bg).

data.rationale: Flat 4px-border group boxes read as a generic form; rounded, filled cards express the AudioMancer brand and group content clearly.
data.requirement: In the theme stylesheet built by build_theme_stylesheet, QGroupBox shall render as a rounded card with a border-radius of at least 8px and its background filled with the theme panel_background color.

data.summary: Green: buttons + inputs border-radius 8.

data.rationale: Consistent rounded corners on buttons and inputs match the card language and the brand.
data.requirement: In the theme stylesheet, QPushButton and the single-line input controls QLineEdit, QComboBox and QSpinBox shall use a border-radius of at least 6px.

data.summary: Green: scrollbar handle border color + accent hover.

data.rationale: Native scrollbars clash with dark themes; themed slim scrollbars keep the surface cohesive.
data.requirement: The theme stylesheet shall style QScrollBar handles with the theme border color and highlight the handle with the theme accent color on hover, replacing the native scrollbar rendering.

data.summary: Green: combobox view + QMenu use panel/text colors.

data.rationale: Unstyled combo/menu popups keep native light backgrounds and default text, becoming unreadable on dark themes.
data.requirement: The theme stylesheet shall style dropdown and popup surfaces, specifically the QComboBox popup view (QComboBox QAbstractItemView) and QMenu, with the theme panel_background background and text_primary text so they stay legible on dark themes.

data.summary: Green: progress chunk uses accent.

data.rationale: Progress bars are a frequent focal point; the accent ties them to the brand.
data.requirement: The theme stylesheet shall fill QProgressBar chunks with the theme accent color.

data.summary: Red: sidebar items have no icons yet.
Red: no appWordmark label in the toolbar yet.
Red: stylesheet has no navigationSidebar selected accent rule yet.
Green: each of the 10 workflow pages has a non-null SVG icon.
Green: appWordmark label present in toolbar with AudioMancer text.
Green: stylesheet marks sidebar selected item with accent left border.

data.rationale: Icons make the workflow steps scannable and express the brand, matching the redesign proposal.
data.requirement: The navigation sidebar shall display a distinct non-empty icon for each of the ten workflow pages (home, text_cleanup, text_chunking, ai_translation, characters, narator_voice, character_voices, speech_blocks, audio_blocks, audio_assembly).

data.rationale: A brand wordmark in the shell anchors the identity from the hero posters without altering the fixed-width sidebar contract.
data.requirement: The application shell shall display an 'AudioMancer' wordmark label (object name appWordmark) in the top toolbar.

data.rationale: A gold accent on the active page marks location clearly and ties the sidebar to the brand accent.
data.requirement: The theme stylesheet shall style the navigation sidebar selected item (QListWidget object name navigationSidebar) with the theme accent color as a left accent border.
